One user called gstack "absolutely wild": you get an agent in conductor.build that drafts multiple-choice replies to your product and engineering questions from Claude. They said it dramatically improved their code quality and development speed.

A commenter said gstack's role decomposition (separate specialist personas for planning, review, QA and shipping working as a team) is the pattern worth noting. They cautioned that its git-clone-and-copy install model works great solo but may buckle when different repos need divergent review gates or QA flows.

Complaint: "Noone seems to have mentioned that Gstack has 'Telemetry' on your usage data," with the user asking whether it's a backdoor for YC to see what people are building. A reply noted you can opt out of it.
